claims.text: Understand Spatial Adjust
claims.note: Tile title.

claims.text: Where moisture scans come from and what the feature does with them.
claims.note: Tile summary. 373-1135 rev 02 opens by naming TurfRad sensors as the source of moisture data and Spatial Adjust as turning it into recommendations pushed to Lynx. The server fetches the scans from TurfRad (SpatialAdjustService.cs:2505-2520).

claims.text: What the feature actually does: turn the latest moisture scan into today’s percent adjustment, and write it to Lynx when you push.
claims.note: Corrected wording, replacing the sentence the ledger marked Wrong (understand-spatial-adjust/summary/1); docs/text-corrections.md §29 gives the claimed and actual behaviour. Verified against production at the cited lines.
claims.previousText: What the feature actually does: turn yesterday’s moisture scan into today’s percent adjustment, and write it to Lynx.

claims.text: /spatialadjust
claims.note: Retyped from behaviour to navigation.

claims.text: The Spatial Adjust dashboard, at /spatialadjust.
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claim understand-spatial-adjust/where/1; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.

claims.text: No dialog open.
claims.note: The push, settings and announcement dialogs open over the dashboard from the toolbar (:94-112); the guide starts with none open.

claims.text: An IntelliDash sign-in with Spatial Adjust access, on a desktop or tablet.
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claims understand-spatial-adjust/before/2, understand-spatial-adjust/before/3; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.

claims.text: Spatial Adjust is a feature of IntelliDash, not a separate product.
claims.note: 373-1135 rev 02 calls Spatial Adjust a companion product to Lynx, reached by logging into IntelliDash. In code it is a lazily loaded module of the IntelliDash site at /spatialadjust (app-routing.module.ts:19-23). "Not a separate product" holds in the sense of not a separate application; access is still sold per site ("Sites that have subscribed to Spatial Adjust").

claims.text: Reaching it means logging into IntelliDash.
claims.note: The module is guarded by AuthGuardService (spatial-adjust-routing.module.ts:12), so an IntelliDash sign-in comes first.

claims.text: Access is granted per user, and the view is admitted only on desktop and tablet.
claims.note: Retyped from prerequisite to behaviour; 373-1135 rev 02 covers neither per-user access nor devices, and the guard settles both. The signed-in user must be a Spatial Adjust user (spatial-adjust-manager.service.ts:185-189), and the device must be desktop or tablet (spatial-adjust-guard.service.ts:24). The environment flag enableSpatialAdjust must also be on (:22).

claims.text: TurfRad supplies the measurement
claims.note: Step title.

claims.text: In the table, find the [[Avg. VWC]] column.
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claim understand-spatial-adjust/2/2; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.

claims.text: Each station shows the average VWC that a TurfRad scan measured, with the scan date beside the station name.
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claim understand-spatial-adjust/2/3; the sentence was reworded for the step standard. Wording changed after expert feedback in the 2026-10-22 walkthrough review. Average, not mean: expert confirmed in the 2026-10-22 walkthrough.

claims.text: If a value is gray and italic, no scan arrived today.
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claims understanding-vwc/2/2, understanding-vwc/2/3; the sentence was reworded for the step standard. Wording updated after the 2026-10-22 walkthrough review (American spelling, station and sprinkler terms); the fact is unchanged.

claims.text: Average VWC comes from a measured scan.
claims.note: Average VWC comes from a TurfRad scan. Expert confirmed in the 2026-10-22 walkthrough.

claims.text: When there is none, it is modeled.
claims.note: With no scan the value is modeled. Expert confirmed in the 2026-10-22 walkthrough.

claims.text: Measured moisture and its scan date, per station.
claims.note: Figure caption.

claims.text: You supply the target
claims.note: Step title.

claims.text: In a station row, find the [[Target VWC]] box.
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claim understand-spatial-adjust/3/2; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.
claims.previousText: Target VWC is the moisture you want that station to hold.

claims.text: It holds a whole number from 0 to 50 that you set for that station.
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claim understand-spatial-adjust/3/3; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.
claims.previousText: It is yours to set, station by station, between 0 and 50 percent.

claims.text: If the row shows [[Avg. Target VWC]], it is a hole or area row.
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claim understanding-vwc/5/2; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.

claims.text: Select a hole row to see its stations.
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claim dashboard-overview/4/2; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.

claims.text: The gap between the measured value and the target is what the calculation works on.
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claim understand-spatial-adjust/3/4; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.

claims.text: Target VWC is an editable input, not a reading.
claims.note: A numeric input bound to targetVwcPercent.

claims.text: Spatial Adjust does the arithmetic
claims.note: Step title.

claims.text: Find the [[Suggested]] column, next to [[Current]].
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claim understand-spatial-adjust/4/3; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.
claims.previousText: The difference between target and measured moisture becomes an amount of water, today’s ET is added, the daily maximum caps it, and the result is divided by the Lynx reference amount to give a percentage.

claims.text: Each station shows a percent: the result of the calculation.
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claim understand-spatial-adjust/4/3; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.

claims.text: If [[Suggested]] shows the same top value on many rows, the daily maximum is capping it.
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claim editing-station-targets/3/3; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.
claims.previousText: In one line. Suggested % = the applied amount ÷ the Lynx reference amount × 100, rounded.

claims.text: The suggestion is based on the gap to your target and today’s ET, within the daily maximum.
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claims understand-spatial-adjust/4/2, understand-spatial-adjust/4/4; the sentence was reworded for the step standard. Wording changed after expert feedback in the 2026-10-22 walkthrough review.

claims.text: The Suggested column is the output of that chain.
claims.note: Under Option 2, the default, Suggested is the server's stored value (sa-algorithm.service.ts:62-65). Under Option 1 it is Target VWC ÷ measured VWC × Lynx Current instead (:58-60).

claims.text: Lynx runs the water
claims.note: Step title.

claims.text: At the right of the toolbar, find [[Push Changes]].
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claim understand-spatial-adjust/5/2; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.

claims.text: It is the only control that sends your changes to Lynx.
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claims understand-spatial-adjust/5/3, understand-spatial-adjust/5/5; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.
claims.previousText: It writes a percent adjust value onto each station in Lynx, and Lynx applies that percentage to the station’s programmed run time.

claims.text: If [[Push Changes]] is grayed out, no change is waiting.
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claim dashboard-overview/5/6; the sentence was reworded for the step standard. Wording updated after the 2026-10-22 walkthrough review (American spelling, station and sprinkler terms); the fact is unchanged.

claims.text: Spatial Adjust never waters anything, and nothing changes in Lynx until you push.
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claims understand-spatial-adjust/5/2, understand-spatial-adjust/5/4; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.

claims.text: Push Changes is the only thing that writes to the controller.
claims.note: requestChangePercentAdjust has one caller in the Spatial Adjust code, the push service (sa-push-changes.service.ts:208).

claims.text: A station row shows its Avg.
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claims understand-spatial-adjust/verify/1, understand-spatial-adjust/2/3; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.
claims.previousText: You can name the three inputs: measured VWC, target VWC and today’s ET.

claims.text: VWC, its Target VWC and a Suggested percent.
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claim understand-spatial-adjust/verify/1; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.
claims.previousText: You know that nothing reaches Lynx until Push Changes is used.

claims.text: Nothing reaches Lynx until you select Push Changes.
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claim understand-spatial-adjust/verify/2; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.
